kernel.syscall.process-crash.before_comm: On both SQLite and PostgreSQL, the armed checkpoint reaches the hold after all checkpoint writes and before COMMIT. The incomplete-checkpoint mutant activation count increases from 1 at arming (the baseline checkpoint) to 2 at faultReached (the armed staged-clear interception). Recovery passes every before_commit assertion: the pending TurnNode is absent, the baseline head is intact, and staging remains. This mutant defers staging clear until after the checkpoint transaction returns; that transaction has not committed at this hold, so the defective partial commit is not exposed.
kernel.syscall.process-crash.after_turn_: Recovery observes that the pending TurnNode is absent and the baseline head remains intact; no durable mutant leaks the node before the head move. The shared wrapper cannot commit an independent write inside SQLite’s locked transaction.
kernel.syscall.process-crash.after_head_: Recovery observes that the pending TurnNode is absent and the baseline head remains intact; no durable mutant commits the head move before staging clear. The shared wrapper cannot commit an independent write inside SQLite’s locked transaction.
